scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix tests/acceptance install && npx --prefix tests/acceptance playwright install chromium && dotnet restore
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "dotnet run --project api/Api.csproj --launch-profile http" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web && npm run check:acceptance
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run build
